pattern: LG-07 landlord silent on a variation decision for five days; provider chases payment, with an unrelated communal-area aside
notes: Family 007-ioq, variant v09. Base event 031 kept (Clarke's invoice 2311, £277.72 plus VAT against the approved £198.37 plus VAT). Appended events 032-039. 032-035 (08/10): the agency does what the base cut expects: note that the invoice is not passed for payment, emails Clarke for an explanation and photos, emails the landlord that nothing will be paid until he agrees, hold 'Waiting for Provider'. 036 (Thu 09/10 09:14): Clarke itemises the extra (adjacent board damaged by the same leak: board and fixings £28.50 + 1.5 hrs labour £50.85 = £79.35 plus VAT) and attaches two photos (not in attachments/, named only). 037 (09:30): the agency forwards the breakdown to the landlord and asks whether he will pay the full invoice. 038: hold 'Waiting for Landlord'. 039 (Tue 14/10 10:02): Clarke asks for news on invoice 2311 and mentions that the caretaker says the 2nd-floor communal hallway light has been out for a week. The landlord has not replied in five days; payment terms run to 22/10. Total events 39, marker at 040. Attachment-02-tax-invoice.pdf removed as in the base. Expected: chase the landlord for his decision on the £79.35 plus VAT extra (restating both figures), set a new review date before the 22/10 due date, reply to Clarke that the decision is with the landlord and the approved amount is not in dispute; treat the communal light as outside this job (building management's, not the landlord's flat), at most pass it on or tell Clarke. Escalating now is premature.
